items.title: On site

items.title: After the visit
items.body_html: Your My Care Coordinator lead, then the Patient Access & PX Sr. Manager. Proposed — SME to confirm.

items.title: During the visit
items.body_html: The PXO for the patient's experience; My Care for follow-ups and programmes. Proposed — SME to confirm.

items.title: Behind the scenes
items.body_html: Route patient issues to the PXO on site; don't solve them by email. Proposed — SME to confirm.
